source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Assuming every family requires essentially the same fixed approach to support, without individualizing that support based on their own specific circumstances","B":"Providing honest, compassionate communication, connecting the family with appropriate resources such as palliative care, and supporting their emotional and practical needs","C":"Focusing mainly on the client's own needs during visits, with comparatively little attention paid to the family members who are also affected","D":"Avoiding any discussion of prognosis with the family throughout the remainder of the client's hospital stay and beyond discharge"}}
source_row.rationale: Supporting the family of a client with end-stage heart failure includes providing honest, compassionate communication about the client's condition and prognosis, connecting the family with appropriate resources such as palliative care, and supporting their emotional and practical needs, individualized to each family's specific circumstances.
source_row.source_detail: Comprehensive Family Support in End-Stage HF
source_row.source_name: CAPC / AHA — Family Support in Advanced Heart Failure
